sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use Mikor? to ask when an activity happens.

mikor breaks down as mi ("what") + kor (an old word for "time") — so literally it's asking "at-what-time." That same -kor piece resurfaces in the very next lesson as the actual clock-time suffix (hétkor, "at seven"). Once you notice it here, the suffix later won't feel like it came out of nowhere.
